title: A Unified Representation Underlying the Judgment of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper investigates 'evaluative judgment' in LLMs, specifically how models represent 'what is good' (valence). It includes a Subjective Preference task that uses 'Deontic' and 'Moral' categories (e.g., moral vs. immoral, good vs. evil) and a Stance-Taking task involving controversial social and ethical topics.
